q: ____ of food has potential to produce safe foods with long shelf life. [2024-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Food irradiation uses ionizing radiation to eliminate microorganisms and extend shelf life safely.

q: In gamma decay, the atomic number and mass number of the ____ and daughter nuclei remain unchanged. [2024-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Gamma decay emits high-energy photons without altering the number of protons or neutrons in the nucleus.

q: An alpha particle consists of two protons and ____ neutrons. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: An alpha particle is identical to a helium nucleus ($^4_2\text{He}$), containing two protons and two neutrons.

q: The atomic number and mass number are ____ in the decay process. [2024-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Conservation of charge and nucleon number requires total atomic and mass numbers to remain equal before and after decay.

q: The rate of decay of a radioactive sample is called ____. [2026-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Activity measures the quantity of nuclear disintegrations occurring in a radioactive sample per unit time.

q: The momentum p of a particle and its associated wavelength $\lambda$ are related by the equation $\lambda =$ ____. [2024-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: De Broglie's relation states that wavelength is inversely proportional to momentum, given by $\lambda = \frac{h}{p}$.

q: Alpha rays are the most ____ of the three rays. [2024-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Due to their large mass and +2 charge, alpha particles interact heavily with matter and cause intense ionization.

q: ____ rays cannot be deflected by electric and magnetic fields. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Gamma rays consist of uncharged photons, so electromagnetic forces do not deflect them.

q: SI unit of activity of a radioactive sample is ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: One becquerel (Bq) corresponds to one decay per second.

q: In medicine, ____ are effectively used in diagnostic procedures. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Radioactive tracers emit detectable radiation as they travel through organs, allowing detailed medical imaging.

q: Neutrons released from a ____ reaction are fast neutrons. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Nuclear fission releases high-energy prompt neutrons moving at elevated velocities.

q: The half-life of a radioactive substance is the time required for half of the atoms in a sample to ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Half-life describes the time interval needed for half the unstable radioisotopes in a sample to disintegrate.

q: An alpha particle consists of two protons and ____ neutrons. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: An alpha particle consists of two protons and two neutrons bound together.

q: A particle of mass m, moving with velocity v has the de Broglie wavelength $\lambda =$ ____ where h is Planck's constant. [2021-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Substituting particle momentum $p = mv$ into de Broglie's equation yields $\lambda = \frac{h}{mv}$.

q: The principle that describes light as having both wave-like and particle-like characteristics is called ____. [2025-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Wave-particle duality explains how electromagnetic radiation exhibits properties of both waves and localized particles.

q: ____ are massless and move at the speed of light in vacuum. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Photons are quanta of electromagnetic energy that carry no rest mass and travel at speed $c$ in a vacuum.

q: Activity of a radioactive sample ____ with time. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: As parent radioisotopes decay into stable products over time, the total rate of emissions steadily decreases.

q: Neutrons released from a fission reaction are ____ neutrons. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Prompt neutrons ejected during fission carry high kinetic energy and are categorized as fast neutrons.

q: ____ is a material to slow down fast neutrons released from a fission process in a nuclear reactor. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: A moderator reduces the speed of fast neutrons through scattering collisions to sustain a nuclear reaction.

q: ____ tracers are effectively used in diagnostic procedures. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Radioactive isotopes incorporated into organic compounds allow physicians to track internal biological processes.

q: When the pants and animals are ____, they absorb and give out carbon. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Living organisms actively exchange carbon-14 with their surroundings through respiration and metabolic intake.

q: The SI unit for activity is ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: The standard SI unit representing one nuclear transformation per second is the becquerel.

q: Einstein's general relativity theory is most useful in the field of ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: General relativity models gravity as spacetime curvature, making it central to astrophysics and cosmology.

q: ____ relativity is most useful in the field of nuclear physics. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Special relativity addresses mass-energy equivalence ($E = mc^2$) and high-speed particles in nuclear processes.

q: An inertial frame is a frame of reference that has no ____. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Inertial reference frames move at constant velocity without experiencing acceleration.

q: Photons are ____ and move at the speed of light in vacuum. [2026-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Photons possess zero rest mass and zero electric charge while moving at the speed of light.
